verdict.rationale: Khoj documents durable, cross-session context only in the sense of retrieval over user-shared files and notes. It keeps them in sync and automatically uses them 'when relevant' in chat, and agents can be given custom knowledge. Nothing in the evidence shows the assistant writing its own memories about the user or recalling facts learned in past conversations. missing for 10: assistant-written long-term memory, automatic capture of user facts or preferences from chats, cross-session recall of prior conversations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
